package.name: ndt_omp
package.description: scan-to-map NDT localization that publishes map -> odom only. The wheel odometry keeps owning odom -> base_link; this node just keeps the map anchored and drops NDT results that do not match the prior map or that disagree with the odometry prediction. ROS 2 port of ia-amr-ros/src/localization/ndt_omp. include/pclomp and src/pclomp are the OpenMP NDT implementation from koide3/ndt_omp, vendored unmodified (GICP left out; unused here).
